enunciado: Write the functions isSymmetric(m, n) and isIdentity(m, n) and test them with three 3x3 matrices: the identity, a symmetric non-identity and a non-symmetric one.
objetivos: Check a property over all elements
Exit as soon as a counterexample is found
pistas: Symmetric: m[i][j] == m[j][i] for all i, j.
Identity: 1 on the diagonal and 0 elsewhere.
Return false as soon as one position fails.
